six_predicates.interpretation: A different start rejects both a containing region beginning before the sample and a later region after a hole. The retained XNU lookup can advance to the next entry; neither direction is automatically acceptable.
Zero size is unusable; no retained B24 size exists to confirm or exclude this branch.
Compare the unchanged strict limit42,717,984. Page-rounding is one possible explanation for an excess, not established by sample nonalignment or whole file size.
Archived XNU records VME_OFFSET(entry). It is a VM backing-object offset, not a universal guarantee that every valid Mach-O/header mapping has zero offset. A nonzero observation remains rejected.
Retained public header defines PROC_REGION_SUBMAP as1. A submap is rejected; no recursion/flavor change or path-only fallback is authorized.
Retained public constants READ1/EXECUTE4 make the expected current protection5. R-only, RWX, or any other current mask remains rejected; max protection is separately restricted by Python to5or7.

B24 has no such raw values, and even that future pattern would not by itself prove __TEXT/sample/target-map semantics.
nonalignment_discriminator.important_terminology: The retained addresses come from the sample Binary Images table. Calling this a proven unrounded __TEXT.vmsize interval is premature: the parser retains numeric endpoints but reads no Mach-O load commands, and archived sample manpage does not specify binary-image endpoint construction.
nonalignment_discriminator.no_current_adjustment: Do not round the existing sample end, clamp/truncate returned size, enlarge the permitted range by a guessed page, replace bounds with whole file size, or reinterpret current FAIL as success.

libproc_wrapper.fact: proc_pidinfo converts syscall-1 to0 and otherwise returns its byte count. Complete return alone is not backing-vnode proof.

full_region_syscall.fact: Zeroes preginfo, calls fill_procregioninfo, then may fail to populate vnode/stat/path independently of final structure copyout/size success. Full byte count does not waive remaining exact identity checks.

vm_region_fields.fact: Looks up containing/next entry; copies VME_OFFSET,protection,max_protection,submap/shared flags; assigns pri_address=vme_start and pri_size=vme_end-start. vm_self_region_page_shift(map) is map-specific context, used here in accounting; source does not equate it with this sample image interval.

public_headers.fact: Compiled public fields use uint64 addresses/size/offset and uint32 protection/flags; SUBMAP1,READ1,EXECUTE4. Older retained header layout is not a numeric sizeof observation for B24.
